head: GigClick is a metronome with setlists for bands, built by a drummer
dek: GigClick keeps a click from 20 to 300 BPM, with setlists you can run on stage, and corrects the delay of Bluetooth headphones. It was #16 among paid Music apps on the US App Store on 9 November.
details: The click keeps playing with the screen locked, and changes apply while it runs. It costs $0.99 with no in-app purchases, by Matthew Whimp, and needs iOS 17.
means: If you play live, your tempos and song order stay in one app.
todo: Find GigClick in the App Store.
